selection_rule: Recreate the archived public OOD selection from the source protocol, then use its seeded fresh selection after excluding every archived group and repeated fresh groups. Preserve source order. Exclude candidate-overlength rows without truncation and score both models on exactly the same remaining IDs.
evaluation_rule: No training, calibration, or hyperparameter tuning on these rows. Use the candidate's already-fitted calibration temperature and the released model's frozen logits. Compare overall and per-kind top-1, NLL, Brier, and Score ranked probability score.
limitations: This tests the local candidate against released Open-Jev, not proprietary TypeSafe Jev.
The selected examples are public synthetic benchmark rows and do not establish desktop task success, safe execution, or model parity.
The fresh split was scored for the released baseline before this candidate evaluation; candidate metrics are not used for tuning.
